title: Compact integral operator evaluation
statement: Let $X$ be a compact topological space equipped with a measurable structure whose measurable sets include its Borel sets, let $\mu$ be a finite measure on $X$, and let $F:X\to\mathbb C$ be continuous. The continuous linear functional defined by integration against $\mu$ evaluates at $F$ to $\int_X F\,d\mu$.
hypotheses_covered: $X$ has a measurable structure and is a Borel space
